evidence.note: This catalog combines a bounded discovery and planning projection derived from two exact non-public coordination snapshots at extraction time with one independently verified public upstream boundary, R020, added on 2026-08-21. The snapshot hashes are retained for provenance, but their bytes and line references are not public in this repository and therefore are not independently replayable evidence. R020 identifies public upstream commit, tree, root evidence files, license, and the doc gitlink exactly, but its full submodule/component census and baseline build remain open. The public_evidence_included flag remains false because no upstream source-evidence bytes are vendored here; R020 supplies exact public locators and identities instead. Null means a field was not established by the evidence for that row; no URL, author, page count, license, commit, or tree was inferred. A translation becomes runnable only after its public source, commit or edition, derivative license, component boundary, and baseline build are independently frozen.
evidence.consumer_rule: Treat every row as discovery or status metadata until its stated build gate closes. R020 has an independently verified public source and license boundary, but it is conditional and not runnable; independently verify component closure, the baseline build, current-production claims, and language gaps before adopting work.
